summary: Sweep mode, 2 backend targets. Created backend/tests/factory.test.ts for createApp and its error handling, and appended cases to backend/tests/router.test.ts for the remaining todos routes. Both files pass, the full backend suite passes (75 tests) and the backend type check passes. No bugs were found.

behaviours: GET /api/todos serves tasks through the repository and the Prisma findMany delegate
GET /api/health is mounted under /api and answers status ok
Unknown routes and methods answer 404 with detail Not Found
Malformed JSON and a null body answer 422 with detail Invalid JSON. and do not call create
Bodies over the size limit answer 413 with detail Request body too large. and do not call create
Unexpected errors answer 500 with a generic detail, hide the error message and log the error
The x-powered-by header is not sent
GET /openapi.json serves the OpenAPI document and /docs redirects to /docs/
Errors after headers were sent are passed on to Express and not logged by the handler
targets.reason: No owner test existed. Created it with supertest on createApp and Prisma delegate spies on a closed-port client. The latest run passed and printed 100% line and branch coverage for the file.

behaviours: GET /api/todos/{id} returns 200 with the task and calls get with the numeric ID
GET, PATCH and DELETE /api/todos/{id} return 404 with detail Task not found. when the task is missing
Invalid task IDs answer 422 with an issue array and do not call get
PATCH and DELETE with an invalid ID answer 422 and do not call update or delete
PATCH /api/todos/{id} trims input and calls update with the numeric ID
PATCH with an empty body answers 422 with the at-least-one-field message and does not call update
DELETE /api/todos/{id} answers 204 with an empty body and calls delete with the numeric ID
POST with an invalid title reports the title field in the 422 issues and does not call create
targets.reason: The owner test covered only list and create. Appended cases for get, update, delete, ID validation and 404s, keeping existing cases. The latest run passed with 100% line and branch coverage for the file.
